title: Immutable Controlled Research Run Manifest
description: The sealed prepared basis of one user-launched run. Lifecycle events and publication results are stored separately.

command_sha256.description: Digest of the canonical immutable RunCommand authorized by the user.

contract_binding_id.description: The required-input or prepared-context ID in the executable phase contract that this manifest input materializes.

role_plan.description: Frozen execution recipe. It declares role-stage obligations but contains no future context, output-artifact, access-ledger, start-time, or closure digest.

allowed_write_root.description: The sole run directory in which role workspaces may be allocated.

contract_output_id.description: The run-local output obligation in the executable phase contract satisfied by this artifact.
